definition: Exact packages with executed evidence: clean-v7 status unchanged-clean-controls or repaired, strict repeat-3 controls (reference [1,1,1], nop [0,0,0]) on that exact package, no source-supported/differential-confirmed finding on that exact package in mimo-defect-map-v1, and (for repaired) a source-qualified repair row on the exact child package.

training_pool_wrong_pass_overlap.interpretation: Wrong passes were executed on original packages; the pool holds repaired/qualified or control-clean packages. Task-ID overlap is not exact-package overlap and does not contaminate the pool, but those task IDs need the repaired grader for any regrade.
